The Ghost (@revolt777)

Local governments in Florida have nearly doubled their property tax hauls—from $32 billion in 2019 to around $60 billion now. That’s an enormous sum built on paper valuations and unrealized gains, not actual cash in people’s pockets.
It’s long past time to recalibrate to reality

Missing Iron Horse, Yankee Clipper, Shoeless Joe, The Kid, among others.


Baseball’s Greatest Moments (@BBGreatMoments)

Calculator allows you to determine property tax savings.  
saveourhomesfl.com

One of the reason not taxing homestead properties is a good change.


Tom Bland (@Tom730410985)

Taxes based upon valuation are ridiculous as an idea. I bought a home in Ft Lauderdale last year and the taxes will go up 50% because of valuation was suppressed by the 3% limit and the prior owner owned it for 25 years. The house won't consume any more than it did and in fact less because there are two of us instead of 5....less of everything.  Complete fraud.



— https://nitter.net/Tom730410985/st

The proposal reduces by 50% the ability of local governments to raise commercial valuations versus current law.


Amb Ace (@global_diplomat)

So all you are doing is shifting the burden to Floridans who own individual commercial buildings which Tax Assessors have riden to death in the last 5 years



— https://nitter.net/global_diplomat/status/2060751199670849587#m

Williams also went to Korea in the 50s.  Would have hit 700+ HRs had he played a full career with no interruptions.


Paul Allen’s Card (@ThePaulAllens)

People forget that there was an entire generation of players who didn’t even play in their primes.

Ted Williams lost his age 24,25 and 26 seasons to military service. 

They saw it their duty as Americans to fight in a war despite being rich and famous.

Absolute patriots.



— https://nitter.net/ThePaulAllens/status/2060753915172323498#m

Amazing stats.  Watching these two guys in the summer of 1941 had to have been pretty special.


BaseballHistoryNut (@nut_history)

In 637 career AB against HOFers, Joe DiMaggio hit 32 home runs and struck out 38 times.

In 617 career AB against HOFers, Ted Williams hit 37 home runs and struck out 46 times.





— https://nitter.net/nut_history/status/2060740529793438084#m

They won’t unless constitutionally required to do so.


Alex Nitzberg (@alexnitzberg)

Would be nice if lawmakers would just vote to balance the budget



— https://nitter.net/alexnitzberg/status/2060743679183040612#m

Enact a constitutional amendment to require a balanced federal budget!


E.J. Antoni, Ph.D. (@RealEJAntoni)

New record high on national debt:
$39.176 billion





— https://nitter.net/RealEJAntoni/status/2060692088820297790#m

Common misconception on property taxes is that local govt can simply jack up valuations — not true for homesteaded properties.


Ron DeSantis (@GovRonDeSantis)

Homestead limits increases in valuations at 3% or to the change in CPl, whichever is lower.  

So it stops them from doing that.



— https://nitter.net/GovRonDeSantis/status/2060737847791899097#m

Underrated.
